null_model: Independent within-tissue permutation of each gene's TPM vector; marginal gene distributions, expression values, sample sizes, genes, and tissues are preserved, while gene-gene sample correspondence is destroyed.
empirical_test: One-sided upper-tail empirical p-value (1 + count(T_null >= T_observed)) / (B + 1).
important_note: The script calls the current multi-DGeNe constructor directly. Therefore the null analysis uses exactly the inference behavior implemented in the local code version.
